facts.fact: The national ICT policy for 2019-2024 sets as measurable targets under 'Local Government' that all Superintendent offices have Internet access by year 5 and that IFMIS is expanded to all counties with reliable broadband by year 5, both shown as on-going; no date is given for the status, so the policy's published date is used.

The national ICT policy for 2019-2024 names the Ministry of Internal Affairs as the responsible body for the target that all Superintendent offices have Internet access, and the MFDP with the Ministry of Internal Affairs for expanding IFMIS to all counties; dated to the policy's published date.
